title: Parallel processing

summary.definition: 병렬처리는 독립적인 계산을 여러 연산 유닛이 동시에 수행하는 방식이다.
summary.mechanism: 행렬과 tensor를 block으로 나누고 메모리·동기화 비용을 지불하면서 처리량을 높인다.
summary.example: 학습의 큰 batch 계산은 병렬화에 잘 맞지만 순차적인 token 생성은 지연 제약이 크다.

researchEvidence.statement: The Transformer paper proposed a sequence-transduction architecture based on attention rather than recurrence and convolutions, and emphasized greater parallelizability during training; this is an architecture result, not a claim that attention solves every reasoning or deployment problem.
researchEvidence.invalidation: The result depends on task, data, implementation, training setup, and evaluation; later systems add components and trade-offs beyond the original paper.

researchEvidence.statement: NVIDIA's CUDA guide models heterogeneous systems with CPU host code and GPU device code, describes GPUs as highly parallel processors, and exposes matrix, tile, tensor-core, and multi-level memory operations as separate performance mechanisms.
researchEvidence.scope: CPU/GPU division of work, parallel matrix computation, precision, and memory hierarchy
researchEvidence.invalidation: CUDA is an NVIDIA programming and hardware model; it is not a universal description of every GPU, ASIC, NPU, workload, or measured performance result.
